DSpeaking: Expressing opinions and agreeing/disagreeing
3Look at the audioscript in Appendix 3 and check your answers to Activities D1 (underlined) and D2 (in italic). Then work in pairs to make a note of any other phrases you know for expressing opinion, agreeing or disagreeing.

Unit 3. D Speaking: Expressing opinions and agreeing and disagreeing. Activities D1 and D2.

Amal: To my mind, fast-food restaurants are here to stay. They are incredibly popular.

Terry: OK, but have you considered other things? If you ask me, people are starting to realise how unhealthy the food is in those places.

Amal: I couldn’t agree more, but they’re so convenient – and cheap! In my opinion people are not going to give that up just because they might put on a few kilos.

Terry: I guess you’re right, and do you know what I think? People are lazy and will always take the easy option.

Amal: Hmm, I’m sort of with you on that point. For me, if the government increased taxes on fast food, the situation would very quickly change.

Terry: No way! That’s never going to happen.

To my mind = D1 opinion
No way! = D2 agree / disagree
Click a sentence to hear it

Page 42–43

Burger Delight

1 IntroductionDo you think we need another fast-food restaurant in town? Your answer to that question will probably depend on how easily you can already access a fast-food outlet, and how much you enjoy fast food.

2 Brief descriptionHowever, whether you think we need it or not, a new fast-food venue is here. Last weekend, Burger Delight opened its doors. It is open from midday until midnight, seven days a week, and moreover, for the next month, all soft drinks are free of charge. Consequently, my friends and I decided to visit.

4 RecommendationTo sum up, I doubt if I personally would return to Burger Delight because of its location. But, if you like guaranteed quality fast food at a reasonable price, then you should visit this new restaurant.

3 OpinionUnfortunately, we were disappointed at the inconvenient location on the outskirts of town. The nearest bus stop was considerably further away than we thought. Although the outside of the restaurant was ugly, I was pleasantly surprised by the inside, which was clean, with attractive décor. In addition, although it was busy, the staff were friendly and very helpful when we asked questions. On the other hand, I was disappointed by the menu because the choice was quite limited and boring. Nevertheless, the quality of the food was excellent and everything we tried was actually delicious. Finally, the prices were mostly very reasonable, and as a result nothing seemed overpriced.

Page 45

Gusto – Restaurant review

How can this place call itself an Italian restaurant? Last weekend my friends and I decided to try the new Gusto. However, we will never return.

Gusto is located in the food court at the shopping mall, and it is open from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. on weekdays, and 10 p.m. to midnight at the weekends. The menu is quite extensive, and moreover there are several options for kids.

To sum up, even though this restaurant has an Italian name, it definitely does not guarantee a good meal. Moreover, don’t expect this to be an inexpensive night out!

So why won’t we go back? Firstly, the prices are ridiculously expensive. As a result, two of my friends had to share a pizza, and none of us could afford a dessert. In addition, we had to wait nearly 30 minutes for someone to serve us. Furthermore, it took another 30 minutes for our food to arrive. When the food eventually turned up, it was at least hot and well presented. But, it was tasteless and although the pizza bread looked great, it was too hard to eat. Finally, unfortunately, we lost our appetites and just wanted to leave.

EXAM-STYLE QUESTION

Writing, formal writing

You recently saw a television programme about fast food. Your English teacher has asked you to write a review of the programme for the school magazine.

In your review, say what you thought of the programme and what you learnt from it.

Here are some comments from other students who saw the programme:

The information about eating fast food was very surprising.
I love fast food more than ever now.

Now write a review for the school magazine.

The comments above may give you some ideas, and you should also use some ideas of your own.

Write about 120 to 160 words.

You will receive up to 6 marks for the content of your review, and up to 9 marks for the language used.

[Total: 15]

WRITING TIP

Read the instructions carefully, underlining the key words. In this task, you have been asked to write a review, so think about the kind of people who might read it. Before you start writing, spend a few minutes noting down a brief plan of what you are going to say.
Plan ideas
  1. Introduction – name of the programme; a question to hook the reader
  2. About the programme – what it showed
  3. What you thought – good and bad points (In my opinion …)
  4. What you learnt – facts that surprised you
  5. Recommendation – who should watch it and why

Readers: students and teachers → neutral / formal style.
